syncSolidBodies()
Bring the solid bodies in step with the solids of this body: one for each solid once there is more than one solid (while AddSolidBody is on), none for a solid whose features are all gone. Done by the body whenever a feature is added or removed and at each recompute; call it after changing BaseFeature or Group by hand.
